title: Image Texture and Confocal Study of Starch-Based Extrudates Reinforced with Vegetal and Animal Protein as Snack Alternatives
content: The development of protein alternatives in the food industry has gained significant relevance due to the growing demand for sustainable and healthy products [1,2]. Extrusion is a widely used process to modify food ingredients' causing structural, chemical, and nutritional transformations such as starch gelatinization and degradation, protein denaturalization, increase of mineral bioavailability, and dietary fiber solubility improving their digestibility, texture, and stability [3]. This study evaluated and compared the microstructure of extrudates made from different protein sources such as vegetal (soy) and animal (rennet and acid casein).
